If nonnegative, both equal `ofReal(closedForm)`. Thus the bridge holds. Our determinant's average is a0. Good.

No: we only use the label arithmetic (positive filter bijection), not the q=1/5 theta packet. The task says don't use S1903's q=1/5 packet; using the label combinatorics is fine.
